instruction: Of the German companies that are world market leaders for (i) warp-knitting machines, (ii) pharmaceutical blister packaging machines, and (iii) film-stretching lines, which was founded earliest? Answer with the company name.

verification.one_shot_breaks: unlikely (workflow can plan all three queries)

provenance.note: Karl Mayer 1937 < Uhlmann 1948 < Brueckner 1960 -> Karl Mayer earliest. Three separate founding-year lookups; same sector -> not heuristically guessable.
